تجتازون (form VIII)
# تَجْتَازُونَ (tajtāzūna) /tad͡ʒ.taː.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَازَ (ijtāza)
# تُجْتَازُونَ (tujtāzūna) /tud͡ʒ.taː.zuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَازَ (ijtāza)
